home.story: I designed the Shield jacket after a winter ride to the sea to pick up a motorcycle. It has ten pockets, one fully waterproof, and a detachable bib that turns it from a riding jacket into a city piece.

about.p1: Samshit is a one-person workshop in Tbilisi. I design every model myself and cut and sew it from the first pattern to the last stitch.
about.p2: Pieces come out in small editions, many with a piece number. If your size is not available, I will make it for you: in a standard size or to your measurements.
about.p3: Inspiration comes from the road, the sea and the old city. Clothes for travel and for every day, for those in love with life.

delivery.p1: Free pickup at the workshop, with a fitting. Courier across the city the day after the piece is ready.
delivery.p2: DHL Express, 3–7 business days after dispatch. The tracking number arrives by email and messenger. Duties and taxes follow the rules of the destination country.
delivery.p3: Ready pieces ship in 1–2 days. Made-to-order pieces take 7 to 14 days; each model page shows its lead time. Capsule pre-orders ship from the date on the page.
delivery.p4: Ready pieces can be returned or exchanged within 14 days. Made-to-measure pieces cannot be returned, but the maker will adjust the fit for free.
delivery.note: Lead times and prices in the prototype are placeholders.
